profile.headline: Principal / Staff Engineer | Enterprise Architecture | Technical Strategy & Platform Engineering | Distributed Systems & Cloud | AI Engineering & Agentic Workflows | Engineering Leadership
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Staff / Lead Engineer with 20+ years of experience building software, leading engineering teams, and solving complex technology problems across financial services and enterprise platforms.

Most of my recent work has focused on architecture and distributed systems, designing microservices, event-driven platforms, cloud solutions, APIs, data integrations, and systems that are reliable and scalable. At Northwestern Mutual, I worked on MoneyCenter, a financial planning and wealth management platform that processes roughly 430K events every day and supports more than $120B in client assets and liabilities.

More recently, I’ve focused heavily on AI-assisted engineering and LLM-based development. I use tools like Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and AI agents to accelerate development, explore solutions, improve engineering workflows, and automate repetitive work. What interests me most is how AI can be thoughtfully integrated into engineering platforms and workflows to improve how teams design, build, test, and operate software, not simply added as another technology in the stack.

I enjoy working where architecture and implementation meet. I’m comfortable defining technical direction, working through architectural trade-offs, reviewing designs, and getting into the code when the problem requires it. My hands-on background includes Java, Spring Boot, React, Node.js, Kafka, AWS, databases, CI/CD, security, and production operations.

Modernization has also been a significant part of my work. I’ve helped replace monolithic and batch-oriented systems with distributed services, improve data and integration patterns, build reusable platforms, and make systems easier to operate and evolve. I’ve worked closely with product, architecture, security, and engineering leadership to turn business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.

Outside of traditional enterprise software, I’ve also designed and built an IoT and building-automation platform using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis, and Docker, with integrations across AV and facility-control systems. That experience has given me another perspective on real-time systems, device integration, monitoring, and automation.

I’m most interested in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, and architecture-focused leadership roles where I can help shape technical strategy, make architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and still stay close to the technology and the code.

positions.title: Project Lead Sr Developer
positions.description:
Lead, Inspire, challenge, and Motivate Teams at Optum for Design, Development, Implement, and Deployments of Web Portals, Consumer Database and Electronics Eligibility Management Systems.

Design and Architect modern end to end web applications using industry standard technologies and tools, Spring Boot, JPA, Spring Data, MyBatis, Maven, Spring Security, and Spring MVC. 

Design and create modernized, responsive, and reusable User Interface frameworks for EEMS using reactstrap, Nodejs, react, redux, router, and npm, HTML5, Bootstrap, JWT, babel, webpack, and JSON.

Streamlined DevOps processes using CI/CD tools, Git, SVN, Jenkins, Artifactory, and XL-Deploy/XL-Release.
